UserCloudProfile.title: UserCloudProfile
UserCloudProfile.description: Per-user cloud profile and synchronized G-Max Game Booster settings and options.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID owning this profile.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In or profile customization.

username.description: Unique gamer username handle (3 to 20 alphanumeric/underscore characters).

countryCode.description: Selected ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, JP).

countryName.description: Selected country display name (e.g., United States).

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

photoUrl.description: User profile picture URL or local cached path.

bannerUrl.description: User hero background banner URL, preset ID, or local cached path.

gamerscore.description: Uncapped Gamerscore points calculated from total playtime and sessions.

dateOfBirth.description: User date of birth string (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD or Not Set).

selectedTags.description: Up to 4 premade profile tag IDs chosen from the 45-tag catalog.

isVerifiedDeveloper.description: True exclusively for the verified developer account Albertomiller747@gmail.com.

mostPlayedGameName.description: Display name of the user's most played game.

mostPlayedGamePkg.description: Package name of the user's most played game.

mostPlayedMinutes.description: Total minutes played for the user's most played game.

totalPlayTimeMinutes.description: Cumulative minutes played across every game session together.

totalSessionsCount.description: Total number of game sessions recorded across all games.

themeMode.description: App background theme mode (AUTO_SYSTEM, LIGHT_HUB, DARK_HUB, CUSTOM_COLOR).

reducedAnimations.description: Whether Lite Mode / Reduced Animations is enabled.

autoBigScreenLandscape.description: Whether Big Screen Console Mode activates automatically in landscape.

showControllerLegendBar.description: Whether the controller shortcut legend bar is shown.

suppressActivationWarning.description: Whether boost activation confirmation dialog is suppressed.

appliedOptionIds.description: Bounded list of applied boost and tweak option IDs.

hudEnabled.description: Whether the floating in-game performance HUD is enabled.

hudShowFps.description: Whether EFPS is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowTemp.description: Whether temperature is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowBattery.description: Whether battery level is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowTime.description: Whether match stopwatch timer is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowRamPct.description: Whether RAM usage percentage is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowClock.description: Whether current time of day is shown in the floating HUD.

crosshairEnabled.description: Whether tactical crosshair overlay is enabled.

lightbarColorHex.description: Selected controller lightbar color hex string.

recBitrateMbps.description: Screen recorder video bitrate in Mbps.

recShowTimerHud.description: Whether recording timer HUD is displayed.

recOverlayEnabled.description: Whether floating recording bubble is enabled.

recBubbleSizeDp.description: Floating recording bubble diameter in dp (28 to 64).

targetGamePkg.description: Last selected target game package name.

targetGameName.description: Last selected target game display name.

libraryPackages.description: Bounded list of user library game package names.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Enforces global username uniqueness and stores public gamer card fields for direct @username profile lookup.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID claiming this username.

displayName.description: Public display name for @username profile lookup.

bio.description: Public player bio for @username profile lookup.

photoUrl.description: Public profile avatar URL for @username profile lookup.

bannerUrl.description: Public profile banner preset or URL for @username profile lookup.

mostPlayedMinutes.description: Minutes played in the most played game.

selectedTags.description: Up to 4 premade profile tag IDs.

isVerifiedDeveloper.description: True exclusively for the verified developer account Albertomiller747@gmail.com.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the username claim was created or updated.

TopGearProduct.title: TopGearProduct
TopGearProduct.description: Curated affiliate mobile gaming gear item for the Top Gear tab, remotely editable without an app update.

category.description: Category chip label (Cooling, Controllers, Finger Sleeves, Power, Audio, Accessories).

group.description: Product group title (e.g., Phone Coolers, Wireless Console & PC Controllers).

badge.description: Optional badge label (e.g., Best Pick, Editor's Pick).

image_url.description: Remote product image URL (or blank to use Amazon Creators API / placeholder).

benefits.description: Up to 3 short benefit bullet strings.

best_for.description: Who this product is best suited for.

affiliate_url.description: Amazon affiliate short URL opened in the external browser.

active.description: Whether this product is active and visible.

last_updated.description: ISO date string when this product entry was last updated.

ReferralCodeEntry.title: ReferralCodeEntry
ReferralCodeEntry.description: Public Squad Invite Guest Pass code entry mapping a short code to the referrer player.

referrerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the referrer owning this code.

code.description: Normalized uppercase Squad Invite code (e.g., GMAX-ALBERTO).

passesRemaining.description: Scarcity-framed Guest Passes remaining in current batch.

validatedCount.description: Total number of squadmates who completed the verified core action.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the referral code entry was created or updated.

ReferralActivation.title: ReferralActivation
ReferralActivation.description: Dual-sided referral activation record tracking an invited squadmate's core action verification and hardware fingerprint.

inviteeUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the invited squadmate (document ID).

inviteeUsername.description: Gamer handle of the invited squadmate.

inviteeDisplayName.description: Display name of the invited squadmate.

referrerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the referring player.

referrerUsername.description: Gamer handle of the referring player.

referrerCode.description: Squad Pass code used by the invitee.

deviceFingerprintHash.description: SHA-256 hardware fingerprint hash binding this activation to a unique physical device.

status.description: Current verification state (PENDING_ACTIVATION until 15m boosted play or 1 HUD match completes).

boostedMinutesCompleted.description: Cumulative boosted gameplay minutes completed by the invitee.

hudMatchCompleted.description: Whether the invitee has completed at least 1 full match with the Floating HUD active.

activationTrigger.description: Which core action triggered activation (NONE, 15M_BOOSTED_PLAY, or 1_HUD_MATCH).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Guest Pass was claimed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the activation record was last updated.

DeviceReferralClaim.title: DeviceReferralClaim
DeviceReferralClaim.description: Immutable hardware fingerprint lock preventing multiple burner accounts on the same physical device from farming referral rewards.

inviteeUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID that claimed a referral on this device.

referrerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the referrer.

referrerCode.description: Referral code claimed on this hardware device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the hardware claim was locked.

RivalsSquad.title: RivalsSquad
RivalsSquad.description: Real-time 5-player Rivals competition squad with leader metadata, 150-character bio, squad code, and monthly season key.

squadId.description: Unique squad identifier matching the document ID.

squadCode.description: Shareable Squad Code (e.g., RIVALS-SQUAD1) for automatic friend join.

leaderUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the Squad Leader/Creator.

leaderUsername.description: Username handle of the Squad Leader.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of up to 5 member Firebase UIDs currently in the squad.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the squad was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the squad was last updated.

RivalsSquadCodeEntry.title: RivalsSquadCodeEntry
RivalsSquadCodeEntry.description: Directory mapping a shareable Squad Code (RIVALS-XXXXXX) to its RivalsSquad document ID.

squadCode.description: Normalized uppercase Squad Code matching the document ID.

leaderUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the Squad Leader.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the squad code entry was created or updated.

RivalsSquadInvite.title: RivalsSquadInvite
RivalsSquadInvite.description: Direct username-search squad invitation requiring explicit acceptance by the invited player.

squadName.description: Display name of the inviting squad.

inviterUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the Squad Leader sending the invite.

inviterUsername.description: Username of the Squad Leader sending the invite.

inviteeUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the invited player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite was last updated.

RivalsTaunt.title: RivalsTaunt
RivalsTaunt.description: One-click pre-set taunt sent when a squad member passes a rival on the Squad leaderboard.

senderUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player who passed a squadmate.

senderName.description: Display name or username of the sender.

receiverUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the overtaken squadmate.

receiverName.description: Display name or username of the overtaken squadmate.

tauntText.description: Strictly one of the 7 pre-set default taunts.

passEventKey.description: Unique pass event identifier ensuring only one pre-set taunt per passing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the taunt was sent.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's personal profile, most played game summary, date of birth, and synchronized app/boost/HUD/controller/recorder settings.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Global registry of claimed lowercase usernames to enforce unique handles and support direct @username external profile lookup.

/top_gear_products/{productId}.description: Remotely configurable catalog of curated Top Gear affiliate products readable by signed-in users and writable exclusively by the verified developer.

/referral_codes/{code}.description: Public directory of Squad Invite Guest Pass codes allowing invited players to resolve a code to its referrer.

/referral_activations/{inviteeUid}.description: Dual-sided referral activation ledger tracking pending and verified squadmates for both the invitee and referrer.

/device_referral_claims/{deviceFingerpri.description: Hardware-bound anti-fraud lock ensuring each physical device can only ever claim one Guest Pass referral.

/rivals_squads/{squadId}.description: Real-time 5-player Rivals competition squads with 1st-5th leaderboard ranks, 150-char bio, and Squad Leader controls.

/rivals_squad_codes/{squadCode}.description: Lookup table mapping a shareable Squad Code (RIVALS-XXXXXX) to its RivalsSquad.

/rivals_squad_invites/{inviteId}.description: Pending and resolved username-search squad invitations.

/rivals_taunts/{tauntId}.description: Real-time one-click pre-set taunts sent after passing a squadmate on the leaderboard.
